## LandingFr

- [Manta Epitech Academy - Apprendre, Construire, Innover](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr.md): Bienvenue à Manta Epitech Academy. Accédez à des ressources pédagogiques complètes, des outils interactifs et de la documentation pour accélérer votre parcours de développement.

## DocsFr

- [Introduction](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/getting-started/introduction.md): Welcome to Docus theme documentation.
- [Installation](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/getting-started/installation.md): Get started with Docus.
- [Project Structure](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/getting-started/project-structure.md): Docus provides a ready-to-use documentation website starter.
- [Web Editor](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/getting-started/studio.md): Build your documentation using Nuxt Studio web editor
- [Migration](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/getting-started/migration.md):  How to migrate your documentation from an existing Markdown solution to Docus
- [Markdown Syntax](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/markdown-syntax.md): Text, title, and styling in standard markdown.
- [Code Blocks](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/code-blocks.md): Display inline code and code blocks in your documentation.
- [Markdown Components](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/components.md): Use Markdown components to help you structure your content, with the help of Nuxt UI.
- [Images and Embeds](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/images-embeds.md): Add image, video, and other HTML elements
- [Match the Shape Tutorial](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/match-tutorial.md): Learn Python programming by solving shape matching puzzles
- [Interactive Tools Demo](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/tools-component-demo.md): Demonstration of embedding interactive tools in content
- [Mermaid Diagrams Test](https://MEA-RUN.github.io/raw/fr/essentials/mermaid-test.md): Testing mermaid diagram rendering in Nuxt Content
